name: Envision (Envision Group)
note: Title brand in the team name 'Envision Racing' (Season 12, 2025/26) and the club's owner; mapped to the kit's front placement per the league's team-title convention. Sourced claims show Envision (a private, Shanghai-headquartered group led by its founder and CEO Lei Zhang) became the team's majority owner in April 2018, but who owns Envision Group itself is not sourced, so the ownership chain does not reach its real owner and the sponsor stays unrated. No human-rights finding of the kind METHOD.md counts was located for the company.
